root_causes: Independent width/sourceWidth and height/sourceHeight canvas scales stretched mismatched aspect ratios.
Inverse affine Export Frame transform also undid frame scale/shear, distorting otherwise correct world artwork.
fix: Centered uniform Fit with min(outputWidth/sourceWidth, outputHeight/sourceHeight).
Clip source rectangle and exact oriented Frame polygon before painting world artwork; padding never includes neighboring artwork.
Frame view removes rotation/translation only; dialog defaults use visual region bounds.
Existing full-original decoding, shared artwork painter, lossless PNG, output limits/cancellation/ownership preserved. No document/schema/package changes.
